notes.title: Weekly News #10
notes.content:
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
[i]Wow, we’ve reached the 10th edition of the Weekly News!
When I started, I wasn’t sure if I would keep going, but I’ve really enjoyed this format, and I hope you have too.
Let’s light a candle to celebrate this moment.[/i]

[h3]Website[/h3]

I’m excited to share that we now have a website with a professional email address.
Check it out: [url=https://gingercatstudios.com.br/]Ginger Cat Studios[/url]
You can now also contact us via email: contact@gingercatstudios.com.br

[h3]Discord[/h3]

I've also created a Discord server for the community! Feel free to join and interact. The goal is to promote new games and updates, but there are many channels for simply chatting about various topics: [url=https://discord.gg/acH2xGeXpt]Discord[/url]

[h3]The King Cat Clicker[/h3]

After Steam Next Fest (October 14–21), I plan to keep the Demo up for a while longer before removing it from the store. I will let you know before doing so, but I recommend playing the Demo if you haven’t yet, as it will only be on Steam for a limited time.

After Next Fest, I expect to receive more feedback and wishlists, which will help shape the changes and improvements I plan to make before the game's release. I aim to adjust some game structures and add an intro, just like in the next game I’m working on. I believe everyone enjoys logos with some sound before a game starts!

[h3]The Next Game...[/h3]

I’ve improved how sound works and started adding background sounds and music to the matches.

We’re close to finishing the first character, and once that’s done, creating the others will be quicker. I think you’ll really like how they look!

[i][h3]Wishing you a wonderful week ahead![/h3][/i]

notes.title: Weekly News #9
notes.content:
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]

[h3]GDWC Participation[/h3]

I’m excited to announce that The King Cat Clicker will be participating in the Winter GDWC (Game Development World Championship) under the Best Indie category.

While winning an award might be a long shot, just being part of such a major event with my very first game is already a huge accomplishment for me. Thank you for your support!

[h3]Steam Next Fest[/h3]

Steam has unveiled the interface for the upcoming Steam Next Fest, which will take place from October 14th to 21st.

Naturally, I couldn’t wait to check it out, and I’m thrilled to see The King Cat Clicker featured in the Adventure/Point and Click category! This event is a fantastic opportunity to grow our Wishlist numbers, and with your help, we’re close to hitting the 200 milestone.

Thank you for being part of this journey!

[h3]Auto Clicker Feedback[/h3]

A lot of the feedback I've received has been about the use of Scripts or AutoClickers.

I see The King Cat Clicker as a casual, fun game where players can enjoy the adorable cats while exploring different visuals and maps. However, I understand that players will always find their own “correct” way to play, even if that includes using external tools like AutoClickers.

As a developer, it’s my responsibility to ensure the game works as smoothly as possible. I’ve tested some of these external scripts and managed to identify and fix some achievement issues and FPS drops you reported. However, I can't guarantee flawless performance with external programs, as they vary greatly in functionality.

For the best experience, I recommend playing The King Cat Clicker as it was designed—without external tools. But, of course, it’s entirely up to you. I create, you play :)

[h3]A Glimpse Into the Next Game[/h3]

As for my next project…

I’ve already completed the settings menu, and I’m in the process of negotiating the character art and environment design. This game will be my big bet, and I’m investing a lot to make it special.

And yes, I’ll continue my tradition of translating the game into all 29 supported Steam languages because I don’t want anyone left out!

[h3]Twitter/X[/h3]

I wasn't planning on discussing this again, but this week, it seemed like Twitter/X had returned—at least that’s what I thought. I even considered announcing that I’d resume posting there, but it was short-lived. Access to the platform is no longer available in Brazil.

So, if you saw my posts earlier this week and were planning to follow Ginger Cat Studios on Twitter, I regret to inform you that there will be no further updates there. However, I’ll continue to stay active on Instagram. If Twitter/X becomes accessible again, I’ll announce it here and on other platforms as well.

[i][h3]Wishing you a wonderful week ahead![/h3][/i]

notes.title: Weekly News #4
notes.content:
[h1]Weekly News #4[/h1]

[i]If you're just interested in the updates, a quick list of changes is at the bottom of the page[/i]

[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]

Greetings my friends, 

This week I updated the Demo version, containing some improvements that will be present in the final version. I believe that this version is more interesting because I do not intend to change it anymore. I will now be working on the release version.

I made some changes to the game page description, including the short description and changes to the wishlist gif, in order to comply with the rule changes established on Steam for next month.

I believe that I will still make some improvements to the description as well as the prints and trailer, so that they are more interesting and similar to the final version of the game, but I hope to have the final version ready before putting too much effort into it.

I'm also creating a press kit, which I plan to use when I start sending emails to streamers, YouTubers and journalists. If you're planning to talk about this game, I suggest you contact us via email to request these promotional materials.

[h2]Updates[/h2]

As mentioned, changes were made to the game and I decided to make them public in the Demo version.

Some adjustments made in this version were to the way the game's critical hit chance works, now it is happening much better.

A button has been created within the settings menu so that it is possible to return the game to its original version, in case you want to create some content about the game, check which are the best upgrades, challenge yourself or just start all over again... this button will be interesting for you.

Some changes to the sound level have been made, 

As mentioned in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3121620/announcements/detail/4366888295505376134]Weekly News #3[/url], I made changes to the way things are saved, I believe the game is more fluid and allows future changes without losing save, not everything is being saved in this new way, but what was important for the Demo has already been changed, for the final version I will be giving more rigorous attention to this function.

I also checked the game translations, some were not appearing correctly due to the way the texts in the game appear, some translations needed more space or small changes and have already been fixed, the biggest problems were in the Chinese, Korean and Thai translations but they have also been fixed, I hope all the texts are now correctly readable.

It is not included in the Demo version, but the problem of the rat making the sound several times with each click has been fixed.

I'm currently working on the rebirth system and the store items that will be purchased using Gems, I'll also be working on adding a volume bar to the menu.

All these changes that I will be making now will be available in the Closed Beta until the game is released. If you are interested in participating in these tests or playing each update, please contact us via email.

[h2]Change List[/h2]
[list]
[*]Demo Version Update
[*]Sound Improvements
[*]Translation Improvements
[*]Luck Calculation Revised
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly News #3
notes.content:
[h1]Weekly News #3[/h1]

[i]If you're just interested in the updates, a quick list of changes is at the bottom of the page[/i]

[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]

I would like to first thank everyone who played the Demo version and added it to the wishlist.

We have reached the mark of more than 250 players (counting only those who downloaded and started the game), and over 80 wishlist additions.

I'm working on some improvements that I intend to put in an update of the Demo Version, my idea was not to modify the Demo Version until the game's release, but I believe that they are important corrections and that they will bring it closer to the quality that I hope to present in the Release Version.

Some Banners and Capsules on the game's Steam page had their art updated, I believe they have a better look now, but I would like to know your opinion.

[b][i]The next Demo Version will feature all the updates described below.[/i][/b]

[h2]Updates[/h2]

I've been working on ways to make the upgrades in the store more interesting, so I decided to create 12 color variations for each kitten in the upgrade store. Previously, there were only 3 or 4 colors depending on the upgrade and they would alternate with each new upgrade purchased. I changed this system so that every X levels the cat's color changes, starting with the color White and reaching the color Orange at the maximum level.

With this, some balancing adjustments were made. Previously, only upgrades that had some relation to time or percentage of chances had a maximum level. Now, all of them have a maximum level. Some upgrades, such as the amount of coins earned per click, which logically should not have a maximum level, will have their "progress" related to the previously mentioned rebirth system. The idea is that it is even difficult to reach the maximum level in certain upgrades. If you do, you will be able to go further in your earnings using the items acquired with the rebirth system. I believe this is a good way to encourage and make the use of this system something fun and not something you intend to avoid.

I created customizations for the drum, following the same logic as the kitten's colors, but here there will be more than 20 color variations.

Some improvements I made to the store interface were also the texts that inform what that upgrade does. Previously, all the texts were described below the item in the store, but I felt that they were visually polluting the player's screen. Now these texts will only appear when the player passes the mouse over that item, while the others will remain invisible.

Also in the store improvements, now the player knows what the next color of the kitten or drum will be when acquiring the upgrade, for example when reaching level 4 in Earnings per Click, the kitten will remain white, but inside the store it will be gray, indicating that in the next level this will be the color of the kitten.

I'm also working on the Luck/Critical calculation, because the way it works today is extremely difficult to happen even when reaching the maximum level.

I am also checking the way the game is saved because I currently need to change the save location to introduce changes to the game's scenario, which may cause some players to lose their progress. I intend to make this improvement in the Demo Version.

I will also be adding a Reset Game button, unlike the rebirth system where you are rewarded for starting the game again, this button will only be for players who want to "delete" their progress, I believe it is something interesting for Content Creators or people who want to challenge themselves or really start everything from the beginning, use this button carefully as there will be no going back.

[h2]Change List[/h2]
[list]
[*]Store Interface Improvements
[*]Kitten Color Variations
[*]Drum Color Variations
[*]Game Save Improvements
[*]Balancing/Adjustments to Upgrades
[*]Improved Luck/Critical Calculation
[*]Reset Progress Button
[/list]
[b][i]They will be in the next update of the Demo version[/i][/b]

notes.title: Weekly News #2
notes.content:
[h1]Weekly News #2[/h1]

[i]If you're just interested in the updates, a quick list of changes is at the bottom of the page[/i]

[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]

We are now in the second week since the game was officially announced, and it is with great pleasure that I announce that the Demo version is now live.

Play, try, and test The King Cat Clicker, any opinion you have about improvements or what you expect in the final version of the game, I will be very happy to hear it, just get in touch on any of our social networks below

I would also like to take this opportunity to thank the Milanote team for giving me additional credits in their tool. I use it as a way to organize my tasks for the development of the game. I cannot afford the Premium version, and the free version has a limit of 100 items. However, by contacting support, they allowed me to use up to 600 items... so thank you very much!!

[h2]Updates[/h2]

As mentioned in the last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3121620/view/4366887026466117600?l=english]Weekly News[/url], I changed the upgrade shop system and created a system to purchase Skins. This way you can be playing with your favorite cat, using the hat you like the most and on the map you like the most. Previously, changes to hats, cats and maps were tied to the level of certain upgrades. When you level up these items, you will still see changes in the game's scenario, being replaced by kittens.

The hats, cats and maps will now be in another layout similar to the store, which we will call Chest, inside the chest you will be able to buy and equip your desired map, cat, and hat, this system is already available in the Demo version

The idea would be to use coins to acquire these customizable items, and certain items will be acquired using Gems, which you will acquire in the new system that I am implementing, which we will currently call Rebirth, you will sacrifice your upgrades and coins in exchange for a quantity of gems, I am thinking of making the items acquired with gems more special because they will give advantages to the player, such as bonuses in earning coins.

I finished the version of the settings menu, containing the 27 base languages ​​and options for Window Mode and Disabling the game's music. I have currently added 2 languages ​​to the game, namely Portuguese from Portugal and Spanish from Latin America, as well as adding the option to disable sound effects. I also adjusted the volume of certain sound effects after receiving negative feedback regarding the volume of coins. These last items were not implemented in the current Demo version, but I plan to put them in soon so that the Demo version has a better experience. My idea is to have a great Demo for the Steam Next Fest.

I made improvements to the scale of some Sprites, which drastically reduced RAM consumption, I believe the game is quite light now.

As mentioned, the Demo version is now available for download on Steam, I also published a version on Itchio, but it will no longer be updated, the ideal is to play the Steam version, the Demo version on Itchio will only be for promoting the game.

[h2]Change List[/h2]
[list]
[*]Demo Version Now Available
[*]Configuration menu with 27 languages ​​and some options
[*]Optimization and Polishing Improvements
[*]Customization and Skins System
[*]2 new languages ​​and option to disable sound effects
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly News #1
notes.content:
[h1]Weekly News #1[/h1]

[i]If you're just interested in the updates, a quick list of changes is at the bottom of the page[/i]

[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]

Since the official announcement of the game, I have been looking for ways to build a community around the game and I think doing a weekly summary is a nice way to do that.

I have also created some social media profiles to post content about the game. They are at the end of this page if you want to follow any of them.

[h2]Updates[/h2]

I conducted a Closed Beta of the game with a few people and gathered interesting feedback. I have already started implementing some changes in the project.

One of these improvements will be the ability to choose which customizable item will be used, instead of the current system that makes the cat's color or hat model random based on the level of upgrades. I intend for players to acquire these items in-game and choose which one to use at the moment, like a clothing selection system. The upgrade store will continue to affect the scenario but with different elements.

I made adjustments to the clickable area of the buttons because, due to the custom game cursor, it created a feeling of not selecting the correct location.

I added some visual elements that appear upon reaching certain levels or the maximum level in some upgrades, providing a more satisfying sense of progress.

I started the process of selecting languages and some items in the settings menu. I will probably have news in the next weekly report.

I changed the map progression system. Previously, you would reach the maximum level of the villages and move to the next map. Now, maps will be a customizable item that you will choose which to use. So, when changing the map, the number of villages that will appear on it will be compatible with the village level. I also added 2 more levels of villages on each map.

The initial number of hats that I intended to have for the first version of the game is already ready.

[h2]Change List[/h2]
[list]
[*] The click area of the buttons has been fixed.
[*] The hats for the first version of the game have been completed.
[*] The layout of the settings menu has been created, and its background music has been chosen.
[*] The upgrade and customization systems have been separated.
[*] Added more versions for each map.
[*] Sound adjustments made.
[/list]
